rationale: ScrollView.clear is the Go method ScrollView.Clear; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration (a boolean or style property is a getter method). Upstream throws `ScrollView child cannot be cleared`; Go panics with the same message (a throw in a void method).

ScrollView.scrollbarTrackStyle is the Go method ScrollView.ScrollbarTrackStyle; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration (a boolean or style property is a getter method).
scrollTo(scrollTop, options?) is the pair ScrollTo(scrollTop) and ScrollToWithOptions(scrollTop, ScrollViewScrollToOptions): Go has no optional argument.
ScrollView.scrollToEnd is the Go method ScrollView.ScrollToEnd; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration (a boolean or style property is a getter method).

ScrollView.updateLayout is the Go method ScrollView.UpdateLayout; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration (a boolean or style property is a getter method).

ScrollView.addChild is ScrollView.Add; upstream throws `ScrollView has exactly one child` and Go panics with the same message (a throw in a void method). Closed as public-api-tested: only tests call it.

ScrollView.removeChild is ScrollView.Remove; upstream throws `ScrollView child cannot be removed` and Go panics with the same message (a throw in a void method). Closed as public-api-tested: only tests call it.
